description: Dybdedata - terrengmodeller 50 meters grid landsdekkende is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kartverket. Grov terrengmodell i 50m oppløsning som viser terrengvariasjon på havbunnen for norske sjø- og havområder. Terrengmodellen har blitt generert ved bruk av interpolering og har derfor varierende kvalitet med hensyn til pålitelighet i posisjon og dybde. Coverage: Kartverket. The publisher named on the listing is Kartverket. Its keywords include Basis geodata, Norge digitalt, sjødata, sjø, fellesDatakatalog, Mareano. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OCTET. The listing shows 2016-01-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
